title: Triage brief: weekly anomaly census and owner map
summary: This brief gives a compact census of quality anomalies observed over the last two weeks for newly onboarded models, assigns primary owners for each failure class, and proposes a short tactical plan to reduce regression rate by 40% over the next sprint.
content:
Context:
We completed onboarding validation for 3 model variants last sprint (gptx-13b-fp16-v2, gptx-13b-int4-v1, rw-70b-lrl). This doc aggregates the regression signals across promptsets used for customer onboarding (+internal stress suites) from 2026-02-26 to 2026-03-11 and maps actionable owners. The goal is to move from signal -> owner -> experiment in the same week.

Key signals (two-week window):
- Regression surface area: 126 unique promptset failures across 18 prompt families (up from 72 two weeks prior).
- Severity split: 18% P0 (blocking outputs or hallucinated PII), 42% P1 (format breaks / loss of required facts), 40% P2 (style/verbosity regressions).
- Novelty spike: requests classified as "distribution shift" increased from 2.8% to 7.3% of failing prompts — suggests recent dataset differences in onboarding traffic.
- False-positive evals: automated pass rate for the onboarding suite dropped from 94% -> 81% for rw-70b-lrl. Manual inspections show 60% of automated failures are real.

Top failure fingerprints (short descriptions + representative example):
1) Context-truncation on long system messages (owner: Miguel Santos): model drops the last 2 system constraints when system length > 2.5k chars. Example: missing "do not invent dates" -> hallucinated timeline.
2) Numeric reasoning drift after quantization (owner: Jordan Lee): int4 variant occasionally rounds intermediate sums incorrectly on multi-step arithmetic prompts. Example: "sum 17, 23, 51" -> 90 (wrong).
3) Sensitive PII hallucination in role-play tasks (owner: Priya Nand): model invents restaurant phone numbers when asked for local recommendations.
4) Unstable JSON-tool-calling output (owner: Ellen Cho): output keys reordered and sometimes missing required keys when memory footprint increases.
5) Tone regression on customer-facing prompts (owner: Aisha Patel): more terse responses, missing empathy tokens for support prompts.
6) Cross-prompt context bleed (owner: Miguel Santos): previous conversation snippets reused incorrectly between parallel sessions.

Metrics to watch (dashboards/queries included below):
- weekly_failure_rate_onboarding_suite (rolling 7d): current 19.3%
- severity_p0_count_by_model: rw-70b-lrl = 14, gptx-13b-int4-v1 = 9
- promptset_novelty_index (token distribution KL): +0.42 vs baseline

Immediate tactical actions (owners + deadlines):
- Miguel Santos: Short-term mitigation for context truncation -> enforce sentinel truncation + runtime warning at 2026-03-15. (Action: runtime flag + alert)
- Jordan Lee: Add a numeric-sanity check harness to onboarding evals and a per-batch rounding test for int4 variant by 2026-03-18. (Action: harness PR + CI gate)
- Priya Nand: Create a focused promptset of 120 local-recommendation samples (real anonymized logs) to reproduce PII hallucinations by 2026-03-14 and run adversarial red-team.
- Ellen Cho: Stabilize JSON output via stricter schema enforcement in the post-processor; proposal due 2026-03-16.
- Aisha Patel: Roll a soft quality bias (prompts to increase empathy tokens) behind an A/B flag for support flows; evaluate on 1k sessions by 2026-03-20.
- All owners: Add one minimal reproduction example to the ticket (ENG-xxxx) within 48h of assignment.

Hypotheses (ranked):
- H1 (high confidence): Quantization introduced deterministic rounding edge-cases interacting with our beam-size/temperature defaults -> numeric failures concentrated in int4 lane. Evidence: failures concentrated on arithmetic prompts and reproduce locally with quantized kernels.
- H2 (medium): Recent promptset expansion included longer system messages from customers; our batching/truncation heuristics sometimes drop tail constraints under peak batch sizes. Evidence: failure time correlates with 95th percentile system message length.
- H3 (low): Model fine-tune for rw-70b-lrl subtly shifted conversational tone; auto-eval thresholds are too brittle. Evidence: manual review shows shift, but pass metric drift smaller than human-flagged regressions.

Proposed short experiments (fast, 48–96h):
- Experiment A: Run int4 numeric-sanity harness across 10k synthetic arithmetic prompts with varied sequence lengths (owner: Jordan).
- Experiment B: Gate truncation at runtime and re-run failing long-system messages against a canary fleet to verify suppression reduces P0s (owner: Miguel).
- Experiment C: Add a soft prompt prefix to 10% of support queries to measure tone recovery (owner: Aisha).

Dashboard & query links (for triage):
- Onboarding suite failures (grafana): https://grafana.redwood/d/ob-suite/onboarding-failures
- Promptset novelty heatmap: https://internal.redwood/promptset/novelty/heatmap?id=applied-ml
- CI gating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/789

Blocking issues / risks:
- Lack of deterministic reproductions for 24% of failures (manual work required).
- Limited anonymized customer logs for PII hallucination repro (privacy constraints).
- CI capacity overloaded for large synthetic runs this week (queue delays 12–24h).

Decision points for next sync (owners):
- If int4 numeric harness shows >60% reproduce rate -> block int4 rollout for non-failed customer segments (Jordan).
- If truncation fix reduces P0s by >50% on canary -> promote runtime truncation permanently (Miguel).

Next steps & meeting agenda (weekly triage, Tue 10:00):
1) Quick signal review (5m): latest failure counts and severity.
2) Owners report (10m): short status on assigned action items.
3) Experiment plan approval (10m): sign-off on fast experiments and CI slots.
4) Blocking removal (5m): ownership of privacy requests and CI capacity.
5) Follow-ups & owners (5m).

Appendix: sample repro snippets (private) and note on evaluation heuristics. For reproductions and private logs see linked Confluence runbook.

Notes to reviewers: prioritize deterministic reproductions first (they yield the best ROI). If you pick an owner action above, please update the ticket with "owner-ack" and a 48h ETA.

Prepared by: Aisha Patel (applied-ml).
